text: かわいい　みかけに　しては　やるわねえ

structure.jp: かわいい　みかけに　しては
structure.en: for someone who looks so cute

patterns.name: 〜にしては
patterns.explanation: にしては means 'considering', used when the result is not what you would expect. かわいい　みかけに　しては = 'for someone with such a cute look'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ gives a feminine tone and ねえ adds drawn-out admiration. やるわねえ = 'you're good, aren't you'.
